['K\u00f6rber AG '].company_description: Körber AG is a strategic management holding company based in Hamburg. In 2022, the group had more than 12,700 employees at more than 100 locations worldwide and generated sales of €2.53 billion. The company is involved in various industries through its divisions, including paper making and tissue converting machinery, as well as other industrial machinery and process solutions.
